title: Capture of the St. Michael
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Capture of the St. Michael", at revision 1370610072, opens: "The Capture of St. Michael or the Seizure of St. Michael, was a Danish seizure of a Bengali ship in the Bay of Bengal. The Danes captured the Bengali ship and the vessel was subsequently incorporated into the Danish Navy given the name St. Michael." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q125804243, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "capture of Bengali ship by the Danes in 1644". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (named for this item in data/imports/wikidata-seeds.json): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
